title: avena sempervirens var. notarisii
intro: Avena sempervirens var. notarisii, commonly known as Oat straw, is a perennial grass of the oat family (Poaceae) native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress, anxiety, and promoting a restful sleep. The therapeutic actions attributed to Oat straw include its calming and sedative effects, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents present in Oat straw include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
